text:
mira: quick flag — the compact run history is collapsing tool-call inputs when function defs omit a title. screen readers get nothing, and keyboard users can't discover the payload. :frowning:

liam: hmm, is it hiding the whole call or just the input payload? can you paste a small example of the invocation JSON? :eyes:

mira: sure — simplified snippet:
```json
{
  "tool_name": "lookup_user",
  "args": {"user_id": 123}
}
```

liam: ok that explains it. two quick proposals: 1) always render a fallback visible label like "Tool: lookup_user" when title is missing (visible but low visual weight), and 2) ensure the chevron/expander is keyboard-focusable and has `aria-expanded` so AT announces state.

alex: +1 to both. also copy nit: instead of "Show input" use "View tool input" — clearer for non-dev readers.

sam: design question: can we add the label without increasing visual clutter? my thought — subdued monospace pill with the tool name and an sr-only prefix "Tool input for" so screen readers read: "Tool input for lookup_user". visually it just looks like a small tag.

mira: I mocked that — attached image in thread (link). also added keyboard hint: press "Enter" or "Space" when focused on the chevron; fallback label is focusable.

liam: dev follow-ups:
- expose data-testid on the pill for e2e
- add `aria-live` region when payload expands for AT users
- make sure we don't break tokenization/highlighting in the condensed row

alex: accessibility copy tweak: instead of "View tool input" for the button label, aria-label should be "View tool input for lookup_user, expanded" or "collapsed" depending on state.

mira: great. let's also add a tiny animation for expansion (reduce motion prefs respected). design will update the Figma and add a11y notes.

ux-bot: created issue PL-542: compact-run-history a11y + tool-label fallback (assigned to @liam) :white_check_mark:

sam: ok, thanks — will pair with liam on the implementation tomorrow. :thumbsup:
